g.text: Loss of function or expansion of
Association must not be read as
They are markers and amplifiers, not
Fibres may raise fatty acids but
Diet acts on microbes and host
stronger if they hit the mediator
Diet and antibiotics act on the host
Donor communities change in a new
Transfer is support, not proof for
A community function can be causal
Judge by patient outcome and safety
Dysbiosis is a hypothesis, not a
